assessment: This work describes a mouse model of a human mitofusin 2- related lipodystrophy, generated by knockin of Mfn2 R707W, and reports adipocyte-specific effects involving activation of a cellular integrated stress response and consequently reduced secretion of leptin and adiponectin. The phenotypic characterization is thorough, and the data are convincing. The work provides important information to link mitochondrial perturbation selectively with altered adipose function, and to show how these effects contribute to metabolic disease.
